evidence.title: These claims about the new coronavirus and 5G are unfounded ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact rated as incorrect the claim that the new coronavirus is the impact of 5G exposure, stating there is no evidence that 5G is harmful to people’s health.
evidence.rating_text: This is incorrect, the new coronavirus is a virus and there is no evidence that 5G is harmful to people’s health.

evidence.title: Maps do not show link between coronavirus and 5G wireless
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated as false the claim that maps show a correlation between confirmed COVID-19 cases and where 5G wireless service has been installed.

evidence.title: No, 5G 'radiation' has NOT caused the second wave of COVID-19 in ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as false the claim that 5G radiation is the cause behind the second wave of the coronavirus pandemic in India.

evidence.title: 5G Testing is not the cause for the second wave of COVID-19 in India
evidence.snippet_en: FACTLY rated as false the claim that testing of 5G towers has caused the second wave of the coronavirus in India.

evidence.title: A retracted paper linking 5G and coronavirus with no evidence is ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact stated there is no evidence for the claim that 5G millimeter waves could play a role in producing coronaviruses in biological cells, and a paper presenting this theory was retracted.
evidence.rating_text: There is absolutely no evidence that this is the case. A paper presenting this theory (with no proof) has since been retracted.

evidence.title: Hoax linking Covid-19 to bacteria and 5G mobile technology ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as false the claim that Covid-19 is bacterial, not viral, and linked to 5G mobile technology.

evidence.title: 5G Testing Caused the Second COVID Wave? Viral Post Lacks ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as false the claim that the second wave of COVID-19 was caused due to testing of 5G.
